budget.notes: Lane 2B only. No trust-kernel logic, workflow, ruleset, hosted registry, Studio, converter, provider-LLM, mobile, promo, release, tag, publish, or human merge action.

conditions: Implementer identity is Codex GPT-5.6 Sol; reviewer identity is Claude Fable 5, relayed by Jon.
Review requests are committed under ops/lane2b/review after slice 2 and at lane close; verdicts are never invented or backfilled.
Every PR remains human-merged and launch remains HOLD with Band 3 as the ceiling while U-17 is open.
No refs/pull/* may be fetched at any point.
Any trust-kernel logic, workflow, or ruleset change is an escalation stop, not part of this lane.
